extraction.Name: Benjamin Janis, junior
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment at the time he received it, because he did not want to pay taxes, but that Mr. Marston, of the Pine Ridge Agency, told him that, if he did not take it they would at length sell it for taxes anyway, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1921, the Bank of New Castle, Wyoming, took it over, paying the taxes, and kept the allotment
extraction.Buyer: Bank of New Castle, Wyoming, took it over paying the taxes and kept the allotment; bank went broke shortly afterwards; he has never been able to get any satisfaction from them; it was a total loss
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: got behind in taxes, and, in 1921, the Bank of New Castle, Wyoming, took it over, paying the taxes, and kept the allotment
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms his father's land for a living; and that is his only source of income
extraction.NOTES: has good health, is mentally competent; has a wife who has poor health, having liver trouble; has two children who have good health and which he supports; has never received any aid from the County, State or the United States Government; document sworn November 26, 1928; 160 acre allotment
